title: Customer Success Executive
description:
**About Neo Tokyo**  
Neo Tokyo is a tech infrastructure company based in Kochi. We design and build custom PCs, workstations, servers, NAS and networking solutions, and provide AMC and professional services. Our customers include individuals, professionals, businesses and enterprises. We help them scale their computing without disruption.

**About the role**  
You take over every customer once their advance is paid, and you own the relationship from then on. You keep them informed while their order is built, you make sure delivery goes smoothly, and you stay in touch long after.

You also run our customer feedback system, which covers NPS, CSAT and closing the loop on every unhappy customer. And you grow revenue from existing customers through AMC contracts, service plans, upgrades, repeat orders and infrastructure solutions. You report to the Communications Lead.

**Key responsibilities**

*Order follow-through (from advance paid to handover)*

* Take over each customer from the sales team once Accounts confirms the advance, and introduce yourself within 24 hours
* Track every order through procurement, build and quality checks in the company ERP
* Update the customer at every milestone, and at least once every 3 working days
* If a delivery date slips, inform the customer the same day with a confirmed new date
* Coordinate the handover date with the build team, and the balance payment with Accounts before the system is released
* Attend or support the handover, and walk the customer through their system, invoice, warranty and service contact

*Customer feedback system (NPS and CSAT)*

* Send feedback surveys on WhatsApp at three points:
* Within 24 hours of the advance being confirmed: NPS and CSAT on the buying experience
* Within 24 hours of handover: NPS and CSAT on delivery and the product
* Within 24 hours of every service ticket or AMC visit closing: CSAT only
* Use the right survey for each customer: a 3-question survey for individual customers, and a 5-question survey for business and enterprise customers
* If there is no reply within 48 hours, call the customer and ask the same questions word for word, without prompting. Make up to 2 call attempts, then close the survey as "No response".
* Record every score, comment and channel (WhatsApp or call) against the customer in the ERP
* Act on every response:
* **Detractors** (NPS 0–6 or CSAT 1–2): call within 4 working hours (2 for business customers). Find the root cause, agree a fix and a date with the right team, and close the case within 3 working days. A case is closed only once the customer confirms the fix.
* **Escalation:** any business-customer detractor, or any case still open after 3 days, goes to management the same day
* **Passives** (NPS 7–8): within 2 working days, ask what would have made it a 10, and log the answer
* **Promoters** (NPS 9–10): thank them and ask for a referral. For business customers, also ask for a testimonial or case study with their written consent.
* **Process flags:** if a business customer rates our understanding of their requirement, or our proposal and pricing, at 3 or below, call them within 1 working day even if their NPS is high
* Tag every detractor and passive with a root cause: response speed, product or solution advice, quote clarity, price, payment process, staff communication, delivery timeline, build quality, service quality, or other
* Send the same Google review link to every customer after handover, whatever their score. Never ask only happy customers, never ask for reviews in the store, and never offer anything in return for a review.
* Prepare reports:
* Daily: status of open detractor cases
* Weekly: response rate, CSAT and rolling 90-day NPS, split by individual and business customers, with open and closed cases and the top root causes
* Monthly: trends, the top 3 root causes with action owners, and progress on fixes

*Customer relationship (after handover)*

* Check in with every customer at day 30 after handover, then every quarter
* Raise service issues to the service team through the ERP and follow them to closure, keeping the customer informed
* Flag repeat complaints and at-risk customers to the Communications Lead the same day

*Revenue from existing customers*

* Sell AMC contracts, service plans, deep cleaning and upgrades to existing customers
* Generate repeat orders, such as additional systems, peripherals and replacements
* Understand each business customer's full IT infrastructure (computers, servers, storage, networking, backup) and identify gaps, risks and upgrade needs
* Work with our Solution Engineer to design and propose solutions based on that assessment
* Renew AMC contracts before they expire

*Target achievement*

* Achieve monthly targets for revenue from existing customers, AMC sales and AMC renewals

*ERP discipline*

* Record every order update, survey, score, call, case, root cause and sale in the ERP on the same day
* Keep a next action and due date on every open customer record and feedback case
* ERP records are audited weekly, and their accuracy is part of your performance review
* A sale counts towards your target only once Accounts confirms the payment
* Meet the feedback-system service levels:
* A survey is sent within 24 hours of every trigger
* Every detractor is called within the time limit
* At least 90% of detractor cases are closed within 3 working days
* Track your target against actual results every day, and take part in weekly and monthly reviews with the Communications Lead

Pay: ₹22,500.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

title: Customer Success & QA Operations Executive
description:
**Position:** Quality Analyst Executive (Customer success)

**Department:** Quality Assurance (QA)  
**Location:** Kochi, Kerala  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail\-oriented **Quality Analyst – Executive** to support our QA team in monitoring post\-admission processes, verifying student records and documents, conducting verification calls, tracking compliance, coordinating with departments, and preparing accurate QA reports.

The role will work closely with the **Sales, Admissions, CRE, Accounts, Admin, Customer Success and other concerned teams** to ensure that student\-related processes are completed accurately and within defined timelines.

Key Responsibilities

* Monitor newly confirmed admissions and verify that student details are correctly updated.
* Verify student documents for completeness, accuracy and proper filing.
* Conduct student verification calls and confirm admission, course, university, fee and payment details.
* Verify Welcome Mail and Welcome Call completion within defined timelines.
* Monitor Onboard, Payment Status and University Registration records.
* Maintain and update QA trackers, verification sheets and pending\-case records.
* Identify missing documents, incorrect information, process deviations and compliance gaps.
* Follow up with concerned teams and executives to close pending cases.
* Coordinate with Sales, CRE, Admin, Accounts, Admissions and Customer Success teams.
* Maintain accurate records of verification outcomes, discrepancies and escalations.
* Prepare daily, weekly and other QA reports as assigned.
* Support periodic process audits and maintain audit observations and corrective\-action records.
* Escalate critical or unresolved issues to the Associate Quality Analyst.
* Maintain confidentiality of student and organizational information.
* Ensure all assigned QA activities are completed accurately and within prescribed timelines.

Required Skills

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Professional telephone etiquette and verification\-call skills.
* Good documentation and follow\-up skills.
* Basic analytical and problem\-solving ability.
* Strong coordination and time\-management skills.
* Ability to work with deadlines and defined SOPs.
* Working knowledge of **Google Sheets, Google Forms, Google Drive and documentation tools**.
* Ability to handle confidential student information appropriately.

Qualification \& Experience

* **Bachelor’s degree** in any discipline.
* Experience in **Quality Assurance, Operations, Administration or Process Management** will be an advantage.

Key Performance Areas

* Accuracy of student and QA records.
* Timely verification of Welcome Mail and Welcome Calls.
* Document verification accuracy and completeness.
* Timely completion of verification calls and follow\-ups.
* Identification and reporting of discrepancies.
* Timely and accurate QA reporting.
* Compliance with defined SOPs and timelines.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Experience:

title: Territory Manager - Energy Based Device
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72\+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.


**A Day in the Life**
=====================

.
  

The Energy\-Based Devices portfolio focuses on technologies that support tissue dissection, vessel sealing, and procedural efficiency across a broad range of surgical procedures. This customer\-facing commercial role partners with surgeons, operating room staff, hospital stakeholders, and channel partners to support product adoption, utilisation, and territory growth across assigned healthcare accounts.  

  

  



This position is based in Kochi and is a field\-based role requiring regular customer visits, operating room presence, account management activities, and engagement with healthcare professionals. Travel of approximately 70% is required within the assigned territory.  

  

  



**Job Description field**  

  



The Territory Manager is responsible for driving sales performance, expanding product utilization, developing customer relationships, and executing territory strategies across the Energy\-Based Devices portfolio. The role works closely with healthcare professionals to support product evaluations, identify growth opportunities, and achieve territory business objectives.  

  

  



**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned**  

  



* Achieve territory sales targets and focus product objectives through effective account planning and customer engagement.
* Promote and support utilization of Energy\-Based Devices products across hospitals, surgical center's, and healthcare institutions.
* Maintain regular operating room presence to support product evaluations, clinical use, and customer training activities.
* Develop and manage key customer accounts, including account profiling, opportunity identification, and growth planning.
* Build and strengthen relationships with surgeons, key opinion leaders, hospital stakeholders, medical associations, and Centre's of Excellence.
* Collect and analyze market intelligence, including competitor activity, product utilization trends, and procedural data.
* Organize approved educational programmes, customer engagement initiatives, and marketing activities in partnership with internal stakeholders.
Maintain accurate and timely reporting of sales activities, territory performance, and focus product trackers.  
* 

**Required Qualifications**  

  



* High School Diploma and 6\+ years OR Associate's Degree and 4\+ years OR Bachelor's Degree and 2\+ years of experience in surgical medical device sales.
* Current or previous experience selling Energy\-Based Devices, surgical products, or high\-end medical capital equipment.
* Experience supporting healthcare professionals within operating room environments.
* Experience managing hospital accounts, customer relationships, and territory sales performance.
Ability to travel extensively within the assigned territory.  
* 

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  



* Experience with energy devices, electrosurgery, advanced surgical technologies, or operating room\-based product portfolios.
* Experience building relationships with surgeons, hospital procurement teams, key opinion leaders, and healthcare administrators.
* Experience conducting product demonstrations, clinical evaluations, and customer education programmes.
* Experience analyzing market trends, competitive activity, and customer needs to support territory growth strategies.
Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams including marketing, sales operations, and commercial leadership.  
* 

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**  

  

The physical demands described within the Responsibilities section of this job description are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co\-workers.  



**ABOUT MEDTRONIC**  

  



Together, we can change healthcare worldwide. At Medtronic, we push the limits of what technology can do to help alleviate pain, restore health and extend life. We challenge ourselves and each other to make tomorrow better than yesterday. It is what makes this an exciting and rewarding place to be.  



  

We can accelerate and advance our ability to create meaningful innovations – but we will only succeed with the right people on our team. Let’s work together to address universal healthcare needs and improve patients’ lives. Help us shape the future.  



**Physical Job Requirements**  

  

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.
‌
‌  



**Recruitment Fraud Alert**

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:  



  

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.  



  

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.

**Job Description**

**Senior Conversion Rate Optimizer**

**Position:** Senior CRO  
**Company:** UGI  
**Department:** CRO Team

**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Reports To:** General Manager (GM)

**Job Summary**

UGI is seeking a highly analytical, strategic, and results\-driven Senior Conversion Rate Optimizer (Senior CRO) to lead its Conversion Rate Optimization Team. The role is responsible for improving admission and repayment conversion performance across business operations by identifying conversion opportunities, optimizing sales processes, enhancing customer engagement strategies, and implementing data\-driven improvements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Conversion Rate Optimization**

* Develop and implement strategies to improve lead\-to\-admission conversion rates.
* Identify bottlenecks in the customer journey and recommend corrective actions.
* Monitor conversion performance across Sales and Repayment teams.
* Analyse customer behaviour and conversion trends.
* Drive continuous optimization initiatives.

**Sales Performance Optimization**

* Monitor sales funnel performance and executive productivity.
* Identify lead leakage and missed opportunities.
* Review follow\-up quality and sales process compliance.
* Support Branch Managers with performance improvement initiatives.

**Repayment Conversion Optimization**

* Monitor repayment follow\-up effectiveness and recovery performance.
* Analyse overdue cases and recommend improvement strategies.
* Coordinate with Finance and Repayment teams to improve collections.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead, mentor and manage the CRO Team.
* Set KPIs and monitor productivity.
* Conduct daily huddles and weekly reviews.
* Coach CRO Executives on analytics, audits and process improvements.

**Quality Audits \& Performance Reviews**

* Audit sales and repayment processes.
* Review customer interactions and SOP adherence.
* Provide structured feedback and action plans.

**Business Analytics \& Reporting**

* Prepare Daily Conversion Dashboards, Branch Performance Reports, Executive Productivity Reports, Lead Funnel Analysis, Admission \& Repayment Reports, Lost Opportunity Analysis, Weekly Reviews and Monthly MIS.

**Process Improvement**

* Standardize best practices across branches.
* Develop and update SOPs.
* Recommend automation and operational improvements.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Sales, Repayment, Marketing, Finance, Operations and Branch Managers to improve business performance.

**Required Qualifications**

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Marketing, Commerce, Operations or related field. MBA preferred.

**Experience**

4–6 years in Sales Operations, Conversion Optimization, Customer Success, Business Analytics or Process Improvement, including at least 2 years in a leadership role.

**Required Skills**

**Technical:** CRM Platforms (Zoho CRM, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics or equivalent), Advanced Excel, Google Sheets, MIS Reporting, Dashboard Preparation, Data Analysis, Sales Funnel Analysis.

**Leadership:** Team Leadership, Coaching \& Mentoring, Decision Making, Performance Management, Stakeholder Management.

**Core Competencies:** Analytical Thinking, Strategic Planning, Business Acumen, Communication, Attention to Detail, Result Orientation, Adaptability.

* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid sick time
